record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, jointly set hidden/embedding width=192 and learning rate=0.0007, retaining one GRU layer, dropout=0.1, batch size=128 and maxlen=128. Greater recurrent capacity may distinguish diverse purchase sequences, while smaller updates stabilize the wider tied, unit-normalized representation. Preserve embedding parameterization, readout, scoring and loss; propagate dimensions through metadata and predictor loading.

category_rationales.rationale: Across all four category models, increase embedding/GRU width to 192 and reduce learning rate to 0.0007. The wider recurrent representation adds capacity while smaller updates may stabilize optimization. Retain one GRU layer, dropout 0.1, batch size 128 and maxlen 128. Existing checkpoint metadata and predictor loading propagate the new width. Preserve tied normalized embeddings, scoring, readout, loss and training limits; enforce the required DATA_DIR lookup.
